label: Switch Axe
note: MH3U endgame Switch Axe centers on Mizar's Asterism (1150 display / 250 true raw, +30% affinity, natural purple, Power Phial) in a Miralis set with Vangis Coil, giving Attack Up (L), Latent Power +1, Rock Steady, and Critical Eye +3 from an Expert talisman/gems. Sharpness +1 is intentionally omitted because Mizar already has natural purple; non-Mizar power-phial axes such as Ceadeed Axe, Brisant Demolisher, Nether Excellion, and Stygian Vanagloria need Sharpness +1 and usually Razor Sharp. The model captures AuL (+20 true raw), CE+3 (+30% affinity), and base sharpness. Power Phial's 1.2x sword-mode raw, Razor Sharp, Rock Steady, Latent Power, Evade Extender, Awaken/poison, and 3U's 1.44x purple (the shared table uses 1.5x) are not modeled. Element Attack Up is not used because the 3U meta is raw/power-phial.
